description: Election Commission - H. M. J. Herath was selected as the member of the Galgamuwa P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member due to a death, which is a matter directly related to electoral processes and local government administration, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
